user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Surfaces content in ChatGPT search answers and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads for policy compliance and relevance.
user_agents.opt_out: Not used to train generative AI foundation models.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content across the web for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs actions initiated by users in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages triggered by user requests, not automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting public web data.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: ClaudeBot Disallow: / in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at users' direction when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves content to answer user-initiated search and chat queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google search indexes and performs analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, and Search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google search and presentation features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content across the web.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls news content for Google News services.
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls commerce and shopping web pages.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools such as URL Inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across the web for non-specific Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs used across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs used across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls sites requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect and index information from the internet for search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Collect data in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple ecosystem and data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Apple ecosystem search including Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Apple foundation models powering Apple Intelligence, Services, and Developer Tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of websites or apps shared across Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays link previews including title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, though security or integrity checks may bypass it.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, and provide citations/links in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for advertising and related business products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches links on user demand and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to improve services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive/noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Allows content to appear in search experiences like Alexa without generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for user requests.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information on behalf of users; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open web data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated crawler sampling a subset of web pages across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
